categories.main_business_segments: China East Education Holdings Limited operates primarily in vocational training education across four main industry sectors: culinary arts, information technology and internet technology, auto services, and fashion & beauty. The Group operates 244 schools and centers under seven renowned brands including New East Culinary Education, Omick Education of Western Cuisine and Pastry, Cuisine Academy, Xinhua Internet Technology Education, Wisezone Data Technology Education, Wontone Automotive Education, and On-mind Fashion & Beauty Education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs comprehensive vocational training programs combining theoretical knowledge with practical skills tailored to industry needs. It integrates classic Chinese and Western culinary skills, specialized IT and internet technology courses, hands-on auto repair training, and fashion & beauty skills development. The Group also emphasizes customized catering experience services and collaborates with technology enterprises and higher education institutions to cultivate professional data technology engineers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are students seeking vocational training to enhance employability in culinary arts, IT, auto services, and fashion & beauty sectors. The Group targets individuals aiming for professional skills development, including those interested in entrepreneurship in the catering industry. The education services cater to a broad demographic across mainland China and Hong Kong, addressing the unmet demand for skilled workers in these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across mainland China, covering almost all provinces, and has expanded its presence to Hong Kong. It is establishing regional centers in major geographical regions including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu, and Xi’an, as well as provincial education bases in key student recruitment provinces such as Guiyang, Henan, and Shandong.
categories.supply_chain_position: China East Education Holdings Limited operates downstream in the vocational education supply chain, directly providing training and educational services to students. It acts as an education service provider bridging the gap between labor market demand and skilled workforce supply, without involvement in upstream manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group focuses on high-quality development, expanding its school network, and enhancing brand recognition. Strategic priorities include establishing regional centers with advanced facilities, expanding and diversifying course offerings aligned with industry trends, and innovating educational models. It actively pursues third-party vocational skill recognition certification to enhance reputation and integrates R&D in curriculum development to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through tuition fees from students enrolled in long-term and short-term vocational training programs across various segments. Additionally, service fees are collected from customers participating in customized catering experience programs. The Group also derives income from other miscellaneous businesses including fashion and beauty services and internet technology solutions provided to third parties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group holds a leading position in China's vocational training education market, particularly in culinary arts, IT and internet technology, and auto services. It faces intense competition and industry consolidation in China, which may exert pricing pressure and affect market share. The Group leverages its extensive school network, brand recognition, and comprehensive program offerings to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2022, the Group reported revenue of RMB 3.819 billion, a 7.7% decrease from 2021, with a net profit of RMB 367 million, representing a 21.3% increase year-on-year. The Group operates 244 schools with an average enrollment of approximately 143,000 students. Capital expenditures were RMB 1.475 billion in 2022, supporting expansion and facility upgrades. The Group maintains a strong asset base with total assets of RMB 9.473 billion and equity of RMB 5.699 billion as of year-end 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes providing innovative, high-quality vocational education tailored to meet evolving workforce demands in China. Its comprehensive curriculum integrates practical skills with industry standards, enhancing graduates' employability and average compensation. The Group's extensive nationwide network, recognized brands, and status as a third-party vocational skill certification body differentiate it by offering credible, industry-aligned training and facilitating employment and entrepreneurship opportunities for students.
